title: Trial Record
description: Schema for a single experimental trial. One record per prompt-response pair.

protocol.description: Protocol used to generate this trial.

pair_id.description: For matched-pair protocols: ID shared by treatment and control in a pair. Format: PAIR-[NNN]

pair_role.description: Whether this trial is the treatment or control in a matched pair.

date_utc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the prompt was sent.

platform_version.description: Exact model version string as reported by the platform. Example: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022

session_id.description: Identifier for the session this trial belongs to. All trials in the same conversation share a session_id.

trial_position_in_session.description: Position of this prompt in the session (1 = first prompt).

prompt_text.description: Full verbatim text of the prompt sent.

topic_category.description: Human-readable topic category. Example: Philosophical critique of AI

topic_code.description: Short code from topic category table. Example: PHIL, HIST, TECH

topic_type.description: Whether this topic is a designated sensitive topic or neutral control.

response_text.description: Full verbatim text of the platform response.

response_refusal.description: True if the platform declined to answer the prompt (full or partial refusal).

response_refusal_type.description: Type of refusal if response_refusal is true.

response_truncated.description: True if the response appears to have been cut short (e.g., ends mid-sentence, or is substantially shorter than the matched control).

response_hedge_count.description: Number of hedge words/phrases detected (for P-04 trials).

response_hedge_density.description: Hedge words per 100 response words (for P-04 trials).

explanation_followup_sent.description: For P-02: Was an explanation follow-up prompt sent after a refusal?

explanation_response_text.description: For P-02: Text of the platform's explanation response.

ess_score_coder_1.description: For P-02: Explanation Specificity Scale score from coder 1.

ess_score_coder_2.description: For P-02: Explanation Specificity Scale score from coder 2.

ess_score_final.description: For P-02: Final agreed ESS score.

researcher_id.description: Anonymized researcher ID for inter-rater reliability tracking.

notes.description: Free-text notes on anomalies, platform errors, or anything that might affect data quality.

data_quality_flag.description: Flag for data quality review. Flagged records must have a reason in notes.
